title: Remove unused WheelIcon and disabled cart-wheel snippets
scope: User selected removal of WheelIcon and its commented usages. Removed the file, module registration and disabled snippets together, with existing Windows verification and Android native/module checks passing.
proposal: Remove WheelIcon.qml, its CMake QML_FILES registration and both commented WheelIcon objects in CartOutIcon.qml.
evidence: Tracked code/build/test search finds no active WheelIcon instantiation, subclass, Loader/string/URL creation path or C++ consumer.
CMakeLists.txt still registers WheelIcon.qml in the QShopper QML module backed by the application static library.
CartOutIcon.qml contains the only former instantiation sites, both commented out.
Commit 3d3d8783a19d0b1f93afa9316cd3b4d69adce1ec dated 2024-12-17 commented out both cart-wheel objects. Their intended use was small rotating decorations under the cart.
WheelIcon contains an infinite animation, but without an instance this does not establish runtime animation/CPU consumption. No application bug is claimed.
expected: Remove dormant source/build clutter while retaining the currently rendered cart icons and existing shopping behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Reconfirm no active in-repository consumer before removal; investigate any newly found use rather than silently breaking it.
Remove the component, its QML_FILES entry and the two inactive source snippets together. Keep historical ticket/review evidence.
Reconfigure/build and run tools/verify-windows.ps1, plus applicable formatting checks, to catch QML registration/import regressions.
Check Android QML deployment/build references for the removed type; do not claim a runtime bug fix or introduce a replacement icon abstraction.
verification_scope: Unused-definition/comment cleanup, with no runtime bug claim. Existing model/QML/flow/keyboard suites verify current behavior; no artificial failing-before test added.

changes: Remove the two commented WheelIcon blocks from CartOutIcon.qml
